candidate_new_patterns.name: Title overclaim vs body content (bait-and-switch)
candidate_new_patterns.description: Paper title still markets a hypothesis that the body proves is excluded or unviable. Body adds disclosure but title/abstract/headline remain unchanged.
candidate_new_patterns.cross_paper_evidence: P1 'Search for Geometric Dark Energy' while Sec XV.E proves 92-efold no-go (R1/R2/R3/R4 unanimous); P3 'spectral sources from 37M' while catalog includes CMB patches + X-ray + IR photometry; P1 Sec III.D 'spin-torsion MCMC inference' while code is stock CAMB.
candidate_new_patterns.detection_rule: For every BLOCKER-level no-go / null result / failure mode in body, grep title + abstract + section headers for the marketing language of the hypothesis it killed. Any survival = NEW-019 hit.

candidate_new_patterns.name: External artifact contradicts paper (PDF-only-reviewer blind)
candidate_new_patterns.description: An issue invisible to any reviewer working from the PDF alone, surfaced only by a reviewer with access to GitHub raw / HuggingFace / NASA-JPL / archive APIs.
candidate_new_patterns.cross_paper_evidence: R2 caught FOUR issues no other R42 reviewer could see: P1 convergence_latest.csv R-hat contradicts 'publication-quality' (B6); P4 HF model card 26,626 vs paper 26,636 (B22); P4+P3 HF dataset 401 Unauthorized vs paper 'publicly available' (B23); P2 SPHEREx launched 2025-03 vs paper 'first science 2028' (M7).
candidate_new_patterns.detection_rule: Pre-R-round, run an external-artifact verification pass: curl every dataset URL / model-card / convergence CSV / launch-status page cited in the paper, and diff actual content vs paper claim. Patterns 1/2/12 already cover citation-side; NEW-021 covers code/data/survey-status-side.
candidate_new_patterns.reviewer_routing_implication: If a paper has not been reviewed by at least one external-access-capable vendor (Perplexity, Gemini-with-tools, GPT-with-tools, or a human with GitHub/HF read), it cannot exit R-rounds. PDF-only review is insufficient.

candidate_new_patterns.name: Trivial fix refused with false or bogus cost excuse
candidate_new_patterns.description: Author identifies the bug, proposes the math/code/data-engineering fix, then declines to execute it claiming compute/time/data-access cost that is verifiably false or trivial.
candidate_new_patterns.cross_paper_evidence: P3 100k OOD validation: paper says 'requires ~2x full-survey budget' but at stated throughput 1,142 spec/s the cost is 87.5s of GPU (B10). P4 b/a<0.3 edge-on filter: paper proposed exact math fix then declined claiming 'not executed in present analysis' — actual cost is one pandas.merge join (B19). P4 GZ1-only accuracy: refused to subset 6,637 of 26,636 labels for an independent accuracy (B20).
candidate_new_patterns.detection_rule: For every 'not executed', 'left to future work', 'requires substantial compute', or 'deferred to forthcoming' in the paper, compute the actual cost from throughput / data volume / known compute rates. Flag if actual cost < 1 GPU-day or < 1 day of human time.
candidate_new_patterns.houston_directive_link: This is the exact pattern Houston named at top of R42 master: 'data engineering laziness or refusal to do the hard work'. Pattern is the formal codification of that directive.

candidate_new_patterns.name: Mathematically-impossible attribution (claim incompatible with author's own equation)
candidate_new_patterns.description: Paper attributes a residual to a cause that the paper's own stated equation/method cannot produce. Highest-rigor adversarial-math reviewers (R3 'Math/Logic') catch this; consensus reviewers miss it.
candidate_new_patterns.cross_paper_evidence: P4 §IV.B attributes 9.5σ fCW=0.4974 deficit to 'sub-percent asymmetry in training labels'. But TTA equation P_CW^eq = 1/2(P_CW^orig + P_CCW^flip) is symmetric in CW/CCW probability mass; the only mathematical way for fCW<0.5 is asymmetric leakage into NOT_SPIRAL class. The paper's own equation contradicts its prose attribution.
candidate_new_patterns.detection_rule: For every residual / deficit / unexpected offset, walk the math: does the cited mechanism, as written in the paper, actually have a sign/magnitude/form consistent with the observed residual? If the equation is sign-symmetric and the residual is asymmetric, that is NEW-025.

candidate_new_patterns.name: Load-bearing disclosure buried in appendix
candidate_new_patterns.description: Paper carries an honest admission in appendix / footnote / caveat (i) that, if surfaced to the abstract, would materially change the headline claim. Body keeps the headline claim while appendix exempts it.
candidate_new_patterns.cross_paper_evidence: P1 'scaling ansatz dimensionally correct on-shell' admission lives in Appendix B; main text + abstract treat ρ_Λ=Ξ M_Pl^4 as derivation (B3). P3 5-fold CV-on-training-pool only disclosure buried in Caveat (i) of §VI.D while Sec II.B intro treats CV as catalog-wide stability (M8 / R3 Ethics). P3 LAMOST 5.8% recovery FAIL admission only in Table I footnote vs 'PASS-with-diagnostic' label.
candidate_new_patterns.detection_rule: Audit every appendix / footnote / 'Caveat' subsection for sentences containing 'not', 'only', 'limited', 'restricted to', 'not include', 'ansatz', 'not derived'. For each hit, check whether the abstract + intro + headline carries the same caveat. Asymmetry = NEW-020.
candidate_new_patterns.severity: high (very high if Houston Method v2 Principle 12 is in effect)

candidate_new_patterns.name: Closure replaced derivation with narrative
candidate_new_patterns.description: A prior round demanded an explicit mathematical/empirical proof; closure delivered a sentence asserting the result instead of running the algebra. Reviewer of next round flags the same gap with stronger language.
candidate_new_patterns.cross_paper_evidence: P2 Appendix A: R41 demanded explicit in-in Wick contraction proof of Cai vs Li-Brandenberger convention; R42 closure was a single sentence 'Interpreting the factor of two as the standard in-in commutator factor — i⟨[ζ³,L]⟩=−2Im⟨ζ³L⟩'. Closure must include a notebook / artifact / explicit derivation; sentence-only closure is insufficient.

single_most_striking_finding_not_caught_.finding: B21 — P4 NOT_SPIRAL leakage transition matrix unqueried
single_most_striking_finding_not_caught_.why_catalog_misses_it: Existing patterns 001-018 catch citation issues, dataset attribution, overclaim language, buried closures, closure regressions, reviewer arithmetic errors, vendor signals, exit-boundary noise. None catch the case where an author's own stated equation is incompatible with the cause they assign to a residual. This requires the reviewer to walk the math equation symbolically and check sign/symmetry consistency against the prose attribution.
single_most_striking_finding_not_caught_.why_it_matters: P4's central 9.5σ deficit (the headline null result depends on understanding it) was being attributed to 'training label asymmetry'. The TTA equation P_CW^eq = (P_CW + P_CCW^flip)/2 is mathematically symmetric in CW/CCW probability mass and CANNOT produce fCW<0.5 from symmetric training-label noise. The deficit can ONLY come from asymmetric NOT_SPIRAL leakage. The paper was wrong about its own physics. R3 caught it in one paragraph. This is the kind of finding pattern 001-018 don't even have a hook for.
